prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: TALKPIK AI public landing page redesign concept
Input image role: the visible source screenshot is a reference image for page purpose, state, and public conversion flow, not an edit target.
Primary request: Redesign 23-X-01-product-landing/default.
Direction: screen-gallery landing.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 web landing page screenshot, no browser chrome and no OS window frame. Use a clean top nav, compact hero copy, one dark primary CTA, and a layered gallery of actual app screens: goal setup, writing editor, AI feedback, analytics report. The first viewport should still show a hint of the next feature section.
Style/medium: high-fidelity landing page UI mockup, Ant Design-friendly spacing and card components, compact premium study-tool feel.
Color palette: #f4f4f5 background, #ffffff panels, #ececee separators, #09090b primary CTA, #71717a helper text. Accent colors only as small semantic chips inside product screenshots.
Typography: Cosmica-like single sans font, weight-based hierarchy, no negative tracking.
Constraints: product previews must be legible enough as visual signals; mascot may appear as a small brand accent only; Korean text is placeholder visual direction, not final copy source.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS window frame, purple AI gradient, blue glow, generic abstract illustration, stock photos, oversized round cards, repeated colorful CTAs, watermark.
